profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at PayPal
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer dedicated to crafting innovative, scalable systems. Currently at PayPal, enhancing user experiences through robust code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led the Web SDK team's integration of the Swish payment method, facilitating PayPal/Braintree's entry into the Swedish market, generating $369M in annual TPV.  

- Developed an automated integration testing infrastructure using WebDriverIO and Browserstack, setting a new standard for the team.  

- Resolved critical security vulnerabilities, ensuring PCI DSS compliance and protecting merchant revenue.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed and launched Book It Now, an instant pricing service that significantly streamlined the booking process for customer shipments, reducing booking time by over 20%.

- Spearheaded the migration of complex legacy UI systems, implementing Next.js, Chakra UI, and accessibility best practices to modernize the technology stack and enhance user experience.

- Led a team of external contractors in the successful development and delivery of a custom Shopify plugin, ensuring alignment with project goals and timely completion.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Served as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for major initiatives, including the development of an API-first product from scratch and leading multiple front-end-focused projects.

- Developed multiple Proof of Concepts (PoCs) for new API integrations, demonstrating feasibility and driving forward the development of innovative solutions.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enhanced the functionality of several Microservice API products, expanding their capabilities to better meet business needs.

- Developed key features for LTL Connect, an integration product designed to streamline partnerships with Less-Than-Truckload (LTL) carriers.

- Leveraged various AWS services to strengthen cloud infrastructure and expand operational capabilities.

- Collaborated within the Shipments and Pricing team to create innovative solutions for LTL partners, driving improvements in logistics and pricing strategies.

positions.title: Front End Developer
positions.description:
- Constructed new page elements in accordance with Adobe XD mock up’s while coordinating with the design team
- Overhauled all product category pages with key features to improve customer experience with better product sample visualization
- Created code templates to be injected into pages with Handlebars.js
positions.insights: Skills: Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · CSS Flexbox · Software Development · React.js · Responsive Web Design · HTML · REST API · Git · Front-end Development · Web Applications · JavaScript · Web Development

positions.title: Field Chemist
positions.description:
- Conducted lab tests on chemicals for Hydraulic Fracturing
- Handled chemical logistics and reporting on job locations
- Handled rig up/rig down of all chemical equipment on job locations
- Customer relations
positions.insights: Skills: Supervisory Skills · Maintenance Management · Training

positions.title: Gas and Chemical Technician III
positions.description:
- Supported chemical operations to supply the fabrication tools with high purity chemicals for wafer fabrication.
- Replace empty chemical supply units
- Equipment maintenance

positions.title: Gas Turbine Systems Technician
positions.description:
- Work center supervisor overseeing engine room operations
- Handled maintenance program, scheduling and tracking of maintenance
- Oversaw work center personnel
- Tracked fuel usage and conducted reports for entire west coast Littoral Combat Ship fleet
positions.insights: Skills: Supervisory Skills · Leadership · Maintenance Management · Training · Management
